title: Wizard Battle Rematch
synopsis: Abracadaniel challenges Finn to a Wizard Battle rematch, and this time Finn has to fight fair, with no magic at all.
plot:
Abracadaniel shows up at the Tree Fort with a formal scroll: he has been training for years and wants a rematch. Finn tries to decline, but Jake accepts on his behalf because the scroll had a nice ribbon. The catch is a new rule at the Wizard Battle: contestants without magic must fight with no tools at all, not even a sword.

Ice King enters too, hoping to finally win, and spends the whole tournament being cheerfully eliminated by everyone. Finn advances by dodging, mostly, and by being genuinely encouraging to every opponent, which throws several of them off badly. Huntress Wizard chooses to forfeit rather than hit him, claiming it would be boring.

The final comes down to Finn and Abracadaniel. Abracadaniel's rainbow magic is dazzling now, real and strong. Finn cannot beat it. He stops trying, sits down in the middle of the arena, and tells Abracadaniel he is proud of him. Abracadaniel bursts into tears, the rainbow collapses, and the judges declare a tie on the grounds that neither of them wants to hit the other. Ice King claims third place by default and is thrilled.
transcriptText:
Abracadaniel: Finn the Human! I formally challenge you to a REMATCH.
Finn: Oh, hey Daniel. Nah, I'm good.
Jake: He accepts!
Finn: Jake!
Jake: Look at the ribbon on this scroll, dude. You can't say no to a ribbon like that.
Bufo: New rule! Non-magic contestants fight with nothing. No swords. No sticks. No shoes with a good grip.
Finn: Cool. Cool cool cool.
Ice King: I'm gonna win this year! I can feel it in my crown!
Laser Wizard: [zaps him] No you're not.
Ice King: Worth a shot!
[Round two. Ash hurls a fireball. Finn ducks.]
Finn: Great throw, man! Really nice form!
Ash: Are you... being nice to me?
Finn: Yeah! You've gotten so much better!
Ash: STOP IT. [trips over his own robe]
Huntress Wizard: I forfeit.
Finn: What? Why?
Huntress Wizard: Hitting you would be boring. I want to see what happens next.
[The final. Abracadaniel's rainbow fills the arena.]
Abracadaniel: I've trained for YEARS, Finn! Look at it! LOOK AT MY RAINBOW!
Finn: [dodging] I'm looking! It's amazing!
Abracadaniel: You can't beat it!
Finn: [sitting down] You're right. I can't.
Abracadaniel: ...What are you doing?
Finn: Daniel, I'm so proud of you, man. You got really, really good.
Abracadaniel: [voice cracking] Don't— don't do this—
Finn: You earned this.
Abracadaniel: [sobbing] THANK YOU. [The rainbow dissolves.]
Bufo: Neither contestant is willing to strike the other. Tie!
Ice King: So that means I'm third? I'M THIRD! GUNTER, I'M THIRD!
Jake: Let him have it.
